admission.justification: Context retention, comparison isolation, latest focus, stacked reveal, status currency and no-extra-read behavior must agree across walk folding, navigation and workspace. The joint obligation no longer promises a keyboard continuation stop or unconditional traversal of all returned roster members.

guarantee: Within one mounted comparison, explicit in-tree selection retains already-read family context without extra reads and keeps the latest-selection focus/reveal obligations. Navigation traverses visible real outline changes; end status belongs to its displayed row key. Partial roster continuation is explicit main-page pagination, not a sidebar keyboard stop. Outside subject selection and review refresh reset retained context; comparison-viewer open/return does not.
title: The walked family tree
